news.title: Family and friends call for justice for teen killed by police in Stockbridge
news.summary: Tyrie Howse, 16, was shot and killed by a Henry Co. Police officer Tuesday evening, according to GBI.

news.title: Family honors aspiring nurse killed in Henry County police shooting
news.summary: Friends and family of Tyrie Howse are demanding justice after a Henry County police officer shot and killed the 16-year-old during a confrontation off Highway 138.

news.title: Villa Rica shooting that sparked fatal standoff tied to homicide: sheriff
news.summary: A shooting that left a man injured and sparked a deadly SWAT standoff on Conners Road is connected to an earlier murder on the same Villa Rica street, according to the Douglas County Sheriff's Office.

news.title: Woodstock woman convicted in near-fatal 2022 home birth
news.summary: A Woodstock woman has been convicted of practicing medicine without a license after a home delivery left a mother near death from severe blood loss, according to prosecutors.

news.title: Man convicted of killing unarmed victim eating outside Morrow supermarket
news.summary: A Clayton County jury has convicted a man of murder after he shot and killed an unarmed man who was eating outside a Morrow supermarket, prosecutors announced.

news.title: Police seek second suspect in shooting that hurt 2 women
news.summary: Atlanta police has released video to help the public identify a second suspect in a shooting at an apartment complex that hurt two women.

news.title: Search for second suspect after shooting injures 2 at Atlanta apartments
news.summary: Atlanta police are asking for the public's help to identify a second shooter after stray bullets pierced two southwest Atlanta apartments and struck two women inside earlier this week.

news.title: Narcotics seized during Operation Zero Tolerance
news.summary: College Park Police seized drugs, firearms and cash and arrested a driver during recent law enforcement operations.

news.title: Lithonia man gets life for killing woman during 911 call at motel, DA says
news.summary: A Lithonia man was sentenced for shooting and killing a woman he was dating while on the phone with 911, according to the DeKalb County District Attorney's Office.

news.title: New K9 finds narcotics during traffic stop
news.summary: A traffic stop in Cartersville led to a woman’s arrest for narcotics possession, all thanks to a new K9 on the job, the Cartersville Police Dept. said.

news.title: Woman raped by three men during Halloween event at downtown Athens country bar, police report says
news.summary: The woman told police she encountered a man dressed as the Joker who offered to buy her a drink. After she declined, the man allegedly grabbed her by the arm.

news.title: What we know about Nick Graham, Lakewood Police agent killed in shooting
news.summary: Lakewood Police are mourning the loss of Agent Nicholas Alan Graham, who died in a shooting that also injured four others, including three agents.
